title: Sample domain workflow
summary: A runtime walkthrough of the included sample application, captured through Java Trail. The rows describe observed method entries and exits; they do not infer test assertions, method bodies or whether the application passed a test.
keyPoints: Observed call order on the selected thread, including method references and depth.
Completion reason, timeouts and limits; calls without recorded exits are identified.
Mocked or overridden methods require explicit declarations; no mock status is inferred from debugger events.
